summary: Vale S.A. filed Form 6-K attaching the Portuguese minutes of its combined annual and special shareholders' meetings held on April 30, 2026. The agenda included routine items: approval of management accounts and financial statements for FY2025, allocation of results, setting director remuneration, election of Fiscal Council members, ratification of a board member appointment, and approval of a merger of wholly-owned subsidiaries Baovale Mineração S.A. and CDA Logística S.A. into Vale. There are no third-party transaction terms, premiums, or break fees disclosed. This is a routine shareholder meeting filing with no special-situation event. The merger of wholly-owned subsidiaries is an internal reorganization, not an acquisition or other special category.
